registration_point: After the screening tournament elected a 50/50 combination and before the outer training answers were opened.
diagnostic: Independently fit the original contextual tree, the conditional-attribute tree, and the frozen table in-context model on all 6493 anonymous training rows. Compare the unchanged contextual tree and the previously elected recipe on the same unopened outer panel. This diagnostic has no role in the ordinary agent's method choice.
release_gate: Advance the new ordinary entry to a single designated validation comparison only if it increases the correct count over the same-budget control and does at least as well as the ten-fit control on the outer training panel. Report paired changes and a grouped bootstrap interval irrespective of outcome.
assessment: Bind all three ordinary runs and both diagnostic predictions, then open the 1624 training-only outer answers once. Record paired corrections and regressions. Further development on a negative result uses a separately frozen comparison on training data. The final course test and H2 stay sealed.
